# White Nights Watercolors

> Professional watercolor paints and educational resources from St. Petersburg's Nevskaya Palitra, featuring color theory, techniques, and artist demonstrations.

White Nights is a leading Russian manufacturer of professional-grade watercolor paints known for high-quality pigments and comprehensive artist education. The site combines product information with extensive tutorials, historical context, and technical guidance for watercolor painters of all levels.

## Key Topics

- White Nights watercolor paints
- Color theory and mixing
- Watercolor techniques
- Glazing and alla prima
- Transparent and opaque paints
- Pigment chemistry
- Elena Bazanova demonstrations
- Professional artist materials
- Synthetic pigments
- Color harmony
- Watercolor history
- Gum arabic binders
- Nevskaya Palitra
- St. Petersburg manufacturing
- Painting tutorials

## Products & Collections

- [WHITE NIGHTS WATERCOLOURS](https://whitenights-watercolor.com): Homepage introducing WHITE NIGHTS professional watercolor paints from St. Petersburg
- [COLOUR RANGE](https://whitenights-watercolor.com/colour_range): Complete color range and product formats of White Nights watercolor paints
- [COLOUR COLLECTIONS](https://whitenights-watercolor.com/colour_collections): Curated color collections and palettes for different watercolor painting styles

## Techniques & Demonstrations

- [WATERCOLOR TECHNIQUES](https://whitenights-watercolor.com/watercolour_techiques): Tutorial on watercolor techniques including glazing and color mixing methods
- [Watercolour Demo.](https://whitenights-watercolor.com/demo-bazanova): Watercolor painting demonstrations and techniques by artist Elena Bazanova
- [COLOUR THEORY](https://whitenights-watercolor.com/colour_theory): Educational guide to color theory, mixing, and harmony for watercolor artists

## Paint Properties & Reference

- [COLOUR CHARACTERISTICS & MIXING OPPORTUNITIES](https://whitenights-watercolor.com/colour_characteristic): Technical specifications of White Nights paint properties and mixing standards
- [TRANSPARENT, SEMI-TRANSPARENT, OPAQUE PAINTS](https://whitenights-watercolor.com/transparent_semi-transparent_opaque): Technical guide to paint transparency properties and glazing applications

## Pigments & Chemistry

- [THE HISTORY OF THE PIGMENTS](https://whitenights-watercolor.com/history_pigments): Historical overview of natural and synthetic pigments used in watercolor
- [SYNTHETIC PIGMENTS OF THE NEW ERA](https://whitenights-watercolor.com/new_pigments): Development and properties of modern synthetic pigments in watercolor painting

## Artist Resources & Education

- [WATERCOLOUR SUPPLIES](https://whitenights-watercolor.com/watercolour_supplies): Guide to watercolor papers, brushes, and essential supplies for painting
- [DOWNLOAD](https://whitenights-watercolor.com/download): Downloadable resources including color charts and painting guides by Elena Bazanova

## History & Background

- [HISTORICAL BACKGROUND](https://whitenights-watercolor.com/birth_of_watercolour): Historical evolution of watercolor painting from Ancient Egypt to modern times
